verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago gives agents first-party access to its documentation. Its MCP server lets an agent search the official docs from inside the development environment, and it also ships a Claude Code plugin with integration skills and a ready-made prompt library. There is no evidence of an llms.txt file or a dedicated machine-readable docs endpoint that an agent can simply be pointed at. Missing for 10: llms.txt or llms-full.txt, Markdown or agent-formatted doc pages, independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can use the docs effectively.
